## Overview



This application offers an API for managing assignments and tasks.



GraphQL endpoint for the same API is [also available](/graph)



<details><summary>Authentication</summary>



> 

> Authenticate using your Erply credentials and get a sessionKey. This sessionKey and your Erply clientCode must be provided in the HTTP headers of every request. You do not have to authenticate against this API - valid Erply sessionKey-s from other sources are also acceptable. To authenticate using this API, use the `POST /api/v1/auth` endpoint.

>

</details>
